newsitem.title: USA: Great Lakes resumes Huron, S.D., service.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes resumes Huron, S.D., service.

text.p: Great Lakes Aviation Ltd said Tuesday it has resumed its United Express service between Chicago's O'Hare International Airport and Huron, South Dakota.
The resumption of service follows a voluntary suspension May 16 of all of Great Lakes operations.
The airline has now resumed about 50 percent of its planned service. A spokesman said the airline is aiming to have full service restored by the third week of July, or August 1 at the latest.
Great Lakes shares were up 1/8 at one Tuesday.
